description: MX, SPF (SPFM merge), DKIM (optional dkim2 group), and DMARC for Dub partner email domains. For subdomain email domains (e.g. partners.example.com), set the Domain Connect host parameter to that label (partners); do not encode the subdomain into record host variables.
variableDescription: %mxHost%: bounce MX label relative to the email domain (typically send). %mxValue%: MX target (e.g. feedback-smtp.<region>.amazonses.com). %spfTxtHost%: SPF label relative to the email domain (typically same as mxHost). %spfTxtValue%: SPFM merge mechanisms only (without the "v=spf1" prefix and typically without the trailing "all" mechanism); see SPFM merging in the Domain Connect specification. %dkimSelector%, %dkim2Selector%: DKIM selectors (DNS label before ._domainkey). %dkimTxtValue%, %dkim2TxtValue%: Full DKIM TXT value from Dub (normally starting with "v=DKIM1;").
